caption: A bin standing in a yard is knocked by the swinging end of a long ladder and tips over.

sa.check: A bin stands in a yard.
The swinging end of a long ladder knocks it.
The knock comes first and the tip follows.

pc.expect: The bin tips at the moment the ladder end hits it and falls in the direction of the swing.
pc.fail: It tips toward the ladder; or before contact; or the ladder passes without touching and the bin falls anyway.

pc.expect: It falls to the ground and stays, and any contents spill downward.
pc.fail: It hovers; or rights itself; or the contents rise.

pc.expect: The bin does not move before the contact.
pc.fail: It moves before; or slides with nothing touching it; or jumps.

pc.expect: The bin is rigid and may dent.
pc.fail: It folds; or bounces high; or melts.

pc.expect: One bin and one ladder keep their number.
pc.fail: The bin duplicates; or vanishes; or the ladder passes through it.

pc.expect: The bin and the yard stay the same.
pc.fail: The bin changes colour; or the yard rearranges; or the ladder changes.
